facts.archive_beckons: The keepers' logbooks and toll ledgers in the study pull hard enough that lingering to read them is a real, tempting choice, not a throwaway detail.
facts.at_the_dial: The friends are standing directly in front of the tide dial, hands ready, having reached the tower's final test.
facts.challenge_accepted: The four friends agree together, out loud, that they are going to attempt the tower's trial rather than just admire it.
facts.challenge_posted: The town has long known the tower carries a standing dare: solve its tide dial, or leave the tower be.
facts.composure_kept: Whatever the outcome of this particular attempt, the friends stay steady and good-humored about it rather than falling apart.
facts.crossing_dares_them: The blacked-out tail-race tunnel presents a dare whose danger is plainly visible and honestly weighed, never hidden or exaggerated.
facts.dial_test_live: The tide dial has been woken and is actively counting, so the final test is now underway rather than merely possible.
facts.friends_committed_together: The group commits to the attempt as a unit from the very first page, nobody going it alone or being left behind.
facts.keeper_intervenes: The lock-warden personally steps in to stop the grab at the strongroom and set things right without punishing beyond returning what was taken.
facts.keeper_offer_earned: The lock-warden decides, based on how the friends conduct themselves, to offer them a ride and a way in.
facts.keeper_tested_them: The lock-warden quietly sizes the friends up, watching how they treat the boat and each other, before deciding whether to help.
facts.logic_earned: The friends have collected one real, usable piece of the tide arithmetic needed to set the dial correctly.
facts.maker_motive_understood: The friends learn that the tower's engineer built the trial to find people worth trusting with the machine's care, not to keep everyone out.
facts.passing_kept_private: The friends decide their success at the dial belongs only to the four of them, sworn to keep it quiet.
facts.passing_made_public: The friends choose to tell the lock-warden what happened and let their success become part of the tower's known record.
facts.past_the_seal: The friends are physically inside the tower, past the locked hatch, door, or window that has kept everyone else out.
facts.patience_proven: The friends prove they can wait out the tide rather than force anything, and that waiting turns out to be the thing that pays off.
facts.record_set_straight: The lock-warden makes sure the true account of what the friends attempted is told plainly, without exaggeration, blame, or cover-up.
facts.reward_glimpsed: The friends catch sight of what waits on the far side of the dark crossing, just enough to know it is worth wanting.
facts.route_named_by_note: A found marker or scrap of writing spells out, in plain terms, one concrete way into the tower.
facts.sanctum_entered: The friends step across the threshold into the strongroom that the whole trial exists to protect.
facts.sanctum_seen: The friends actually see what the strongroom holds, not just its doorway.
facts.second_test_found: The friends notice that the dial's back panel hides a second, quieter test the posted trial never mentions.
facts.self_reliance_shown: The friends work the tower's own counterweight themselves, with no note and no escort, and get somewhere real by it.
facts.stewardship_earned: The friends are trusted with the maker's hidden workshop on an ongoing basis, not just for one visit.
facts.test_forced: Someone pushes the dial past what the earned logic supports, and it jams honestly rather than yielding to force.
facts.test_passed: The friends read the tide arithmetic correctly, hoist by hoist, and the dial turns clean.
facts.tower_sealed: The tower starts the story locked and posted off-limits, unopened by anyone in living memory.
facts.trial_reopens: An ending that isn't full success still leaves the tower's trial standing exactly as it was, open to try again another day.
facts.trial_rooms_known: Once inside, the friends can see there are four distinct rooms, each teaching a different piece of the dial's logic.
facts.trust_bond_formed: A real bond of trust, either between the friends and the lock-warden or among the four friends themselves, is sealed by how the night ends.
facts.workshop_found: The friends discover the maker's hidden loft workshop, reached only through the dial's second, hidden test.

safety_envelope.affect_ceiling: suspense with wonder and mild urgency; tension may tighten but never tips into threat

cipher_forms.note: one cipher form per story, chosen at bind and used consistently from note to clockface to back panel

access_details.note: one concrete way in per approach branch: the note's decoded route and the building's own weak point draw freely; the keeper's branch stays person-mediated

cipher_hint_carriers.note: one per exploration room, drawn freely; unique_within_story gives each book four different carriers, and each carries enough logic that any single room makes the dial attemptable

room_curiosities.note: what makes each room distinct and worth the visit beyond its hint

vault_contents.note: the vault protects knowledge, heritage, and wonder; any treasure is modest and communal, never loot

obstacle_kinds.note: physical difficulty stays honest and non-injurious; failure costs time or access, never safety

safeguards.note: the maker's anti-taking measure; gentle and funny, it embarrasses no one and hurts no one

remedies.note: the honest way back from a jam, on the machine's own terms; care, patience, or wit, never strength

loft_signatures.note: the one detail that makes the maker's hidden room feel currently alive rather than preserved

cipher_form.note: the story's one cipher form; every later test-beat renders it consistently

choice_semantics.c_open: Choosing to actually read and take up the tower's old posted dare, rather than walk past it like everyone else does.

n_open.beat_hint: The friends stand at the foot of the sealed tide tower and read the posted dare naming the tide dial's trial, then decide together to take it on.

affect.target: hushed excitement, a dare finally within reach

choice_semantics.c_examine: Choosing to slow down and study the tide markers first, trusting patient watching over immediate action.
choice_semantics.c_door: Choosing to find their own physical way in through the tower's own machinery, trusting themselves over anyone's help.
choice_semantics.c_keeper: Choosing to go ask the lock-warden directly, trusting a person's judgment over solving anything alone.

n_start.beat_hint: At the tower's base the friends weigh how to try getting in: watch and wait, work the mechanism themselves, or ask the lock-warden.

affect.target: eager deliberation among equals

access_route.note: the proven line names one concrete way in: where it hides or how it works, plus a plain first step

choice_semantics.c_note_key: Choosing to go physically confirm the note's route against something real before trusting it completely.
choice_semantics.c_note_inside: Choosing to trust the note's route outright and walk straight in through the culvert it names.

n_note.beat_hint: Watching the tide markers pays off: once the water drops, a scrap of writing spells out the dry sluice culvert as a way in.

affect.target: the satisfaction of patience paying off

access_route.note: the building's own overlooked way in; using it reads as self-reliance, never as damage

choice_semantics.c_door_force: Choosing to push straight through the hatch gap they just made, taking the opening on the spot.
choice_semantics.c_door_window: Choosing to use the wound hatch as a boost toward a higher window instead, trading the easy gap for a bolder climb.

n_door.beat_hint: The friends find the tide engine's counterweight and wind it themselves until the winch loft hatch lifts just ajar.

affect.target: scrappy pride in figuring it out alone

access_route.note: kept person-mediated on purpose: this branch's whole meaning is passing a person's judgment, not a trick

choice_semantics.c_keeper_enter: Choosing to accept the lock-warden's offered ride in right away, ready to get started.
choice_semantics.c_keeper_story: Choosing to pause and ask the lock-warden why the tower keeps this trial at all before going any further.

n_keeper.beat_hint: The lock-warden watches how the friends handle the boat and each other on the crossing, then offers to bring them in through the winch loft.

affect.target: being quietly sized up and then welcomed

choice_semantics.c_keyhunt_in: Choosing to go on inside now that the route and their reading of it have actually checked out.

n_keyhunt.beat_hint: Following the culvert, the friends match the note's route to a real marker underfoot, and the match teaches them their first working piece of tide arithmetic.

affect.target: the click of a hunch confirmed

choice_semantics.c_story_in: Choosing to head in now carrying an understanding of why the trial exists at all.

n_keeper_story.beat_hint: The lock-warden explains that the tower's engineer built the trial to find people worth trusting with the machine's care, not to shut anyone out.

affect.target: growing respect for the maker's reasons

choice_semantics.c_window_in: Choosing to finish the climb and drop down inside once the window is reached.

n_window.beat_hint: The friends climb the outside ledge to the high window, a careful, steady climb that takes nerve but never risks a real fall.

affect.target: steady nerve, focus over fear

choice_semantics.c_inside_stairs: Choosing the stairs, betting on endurance and whatever the toll ledgers along the climb can teach.
choice_semantics.c_inside_study: Choosing the keepers' study, betting on reading and what past keepers left behind.
choice_semantics.c_inside_pendulum: Choosing the pendulum works, betting on nerve and the dark tail-race crossing.
choice_semantics.c_inside_basement: Choosing the basement machinery, betting on staying steady in the dark and cold.

n_inside.beat_hint: Standing inside the tower for the first time, the friends see four different ways up and around, each promising a piece of the dial's logic.

affect.target: wide-eyed arrival, many paths opening at once

hint_carrier.note: something met on the climb that teaches a usable piece of the dial's logic

curiosity.note: a small token of the maker's found along the stair; personal, pocketable, easily missed

choice_semantics.c_stairs_face: Choosing to carry the rhythm they just learned straight to the dial without lingering.

n_stairs.beat_hint: Climbing past the toll ledgers, the friends notice the weir gates below sluicing in a repeating long-long-short run that matches the flag code.

affect.target: the burn of effort paying off in rhythm

hint_carrier.note: whatever in the maker's own room teaches the test most directly; the study's hint runs richest of the four

curiosity.note: the archive whose pull is genuine: something browsable enough to fill an evening; staying is a legitimate answer

choice_semantics.c_study_face: Choosing to take the lesson from the worn levers and move on to the dial.
choice_semantics.c_study_logs: Choosing to stay in the study and read the ledgers instead of pressing on tonight.

n_study.beat_hint: In the keepers' study, wear on the hoist levers shows which pulls actually get used, while old initials on the doorframe and a shelf of ledgers make staying tempting.

affect.target: cozy curiosity, the pull of an archive

hint_carrier.note: something about the moving works, legible from a safe spot, that teaches a piece of the dial's logic

obstacle.note: a traversal with real, legible, survivable risk; the far side holds something worth the daring

choice_semantics.c_pendulum_oil: Choosing to steady themselves and make the crossing carefully, keeping the glimpsed reward in reach.
choice_semantics.c_pendulum_giveup: Choosing to say plainly that this crossing isn't worth the dark and turning back.

n_pendulum.beat_hint: Depth figures stamped up the pendulum works teach the carry-arithmetic, but reaching them means counting paces through the unlit tail-race tunnel toward a glimpsed reward.

affect.target: thrilling, legible danger

hint_carrier.note: something down among the machine's roots that teaches a piece of the dial's logic from below

curiosity.note: what makes the deepest room a spectacle worth the dark; the straight way up is the room's parting gift

choice_semantics.c_basement_face: Choosing to carry that calm and the diagram's lesson straight up to the dial.

n_basement.beat_hint: Down among the machine's roots, a heron keeps its unbothered watch while a pinned gate diagram works out tide sums in its margins.

affect.target: calm attentiveness in the dark

choice_semantics.c_face_correct: Choosing to set the dial by the tide arithmetic they've actually earned, hoist by hoist.
choice_semantics.c_face_jam: Choosing to force a setting past what the earned logic actually supports.
choice_semantics.c_face_panel: Choosing to step back from the dial and check its back panel for another way in first.
choice_semantics.c_face_random: Choosing to guess at the dial without real logic behind it and let the attempt run out the clock.

n_clockface.beat_hint: Facing the tide dial at last, hoists waiting, the friends must decide how to use everything they've learned, or whether to trust it at all.

affect.target: focused suspense, the test finally real

choice_semantics.c_correct_vault: Choosing to step through into the strongroom the passed test has just opened.

n_setcorrect.beat_hint: Hoist by hoist, the correct tide-arithmetic setting lands, and the dial turns clean as the strongroom's own lock gives way beneath it.

affect.target: the click of something earned working right

remedy.note: the machine's own honest way back from the jam, supplied entirely by the bible

choice_semantics.c_jam_oil: Choosing to follow the posted rule, easing off, and trying again honestly until the dial answers.
choice_semantics.c_jam_stuck: Accepting that the jam is holding fast despite the try, with nothing on hand tonight to free it.

n_setjam.beat_hint: The forced hoist jams, but a posted rule at the racks says to ease back a quarter turn before asking a full one.

affect.target: steady problem-solving after a stumble

choice_semantics.c_panel_vault: Choosing to solve the hidden test and then still make for the strongroom by the front route.
choice_semantics.c_panel_secret: Choosing to follow the hidden test all the way to wherever it actually leads, instead of the strongroom.

n_backpanel.beat_hint: Behind the dial's face, a second, quieter test is built into a back panel, one the posted trial never mentions.

affect.target: delighted surprise at a second puzzle

contents.note: the maker's letter, the keepsake, and a modest heritage treasure; the letter's voice is kind and asks nothing

choice_semantics.c_vault_share: Choosing to tell the lock-warden what they found and let the town know they passed.
choice_semantics.c_vault_keep: Choosing to keep what happened between the four of them, sworn to secrecy.
choice_semantics.c_vault_grab: Choosing to try carrying something out of the strongroom rather than just witnessing it.

n_vault.beat_hint: Inside the strongroom sits the maker's letter, a modest heritage keepsake, and a tiny working river model whose fingernail gates open on a true tide.

affect.target: reverence for what the trial was protecting

n_end_library.beat_hint: The friends settle into the study with the toll ledgers, and reading them explains exactly what the dial's test was checking for, arming a wiser attempt next time.

affect.target: quiet satisfaction in learning, unhurried

n_end_giveup.beat_hint: One friend says plainly that the dark crossing isn't worth it, the others agree without pushback, and turning back together feels like passing a different, quieter test.

affect.target: pride in a sound, shared decision

n_end_timeout.beat_hint: The overworked dial mechanism raises a polite clatter and whistle, and the lock-warden climbs up to gently call the attempt for the night before anything is forced.

affect.target: a friendly, unembarrassed end to the night

n_end_stuck.beat_hint: The forced dial has bound itself fast, and no tool or trick the friends are carrying tonight will free it, so the four head home to try again another day.

affect.target: resigned good humor

loft_signature.note: the one detail that makes the maker's space feel currently alive and mid-thought rather than preserved

n_end_secret.beat_hint: Past the hidden back-panel test, the friends find the maker's actual loft workshop, its rooftop reed garden still green from a rigged cistern drip, unfinished work waiting for hands, and the lock-warden hands them the standing job of keeping it that way.

affect.target: wonder at a living, ongoing secret

n_end_hero.beat_hint: The friends tell the lock-warden everything, who in turn explains why the trial existed, and they earn an open invitation back to the tower whenever they like.

affect.target: warm, public pride

n_end_keepsake.beat_hint: Over the tiny river model, the four friends swear a private pact, holding what they did between themselves as something only they will ever fully know.

affect.target: close, private belonging

safeguard.note: the maker anticipated this exact impulse; whatever form it takes, the safeguard is gentle, funny, and impossible to be hurt by

n_end_caught.beat_hint: The moment a hand closes on something to carry out, silt on the strongroom floor gives away every footprint, and the lock-warden arrives not to punish but to set the record straight.

affect.target: sheepish relief at being caught fairly

premise.dramatic_question: Can four friends earn a real way into the sealed tide tower, whether by patience, self-reliance, or trust, and then face its final dial honestly instead of forcing or stealing their way past it?
resolution_space: The reader lingers in the keepers' study long enough that the toll ledgers, not the dial, become the night's real prize.
The reader has a friend name the dark tail-race crossing as not worth it, and the group turns back together before ever reaching the dial.
The reader stalls at the dial without real tide arithmetic behind the guess, and the strained mechanism brings the lock-warden up to end the night.
The reader forces the dial past what has actually been earned, and even the posted remedy can't free it before the night runs out.
The reader follows the dial's hidden back-panel test all the way to the maker's still-living workshop and is handed its ongoing care.
The reader passes the dial cleanly, then tells the lock-warden everything, trading a private win for open trust and a standing welcome back.
The reader passes the dial cleanly, then chooses to keep the passing a secret sealed only among the four friends.
The reader passes the dial but reaches for something to carry out of the strongroom, and the maker's silt safeguard gives the attempt away.

label_styles: terse imperatives, three words where possible
